cc:Work.dc:title: f03_transaction
cc:Work.dc:description: The upper panel shows four first-transaction pairs: two crossing repeats at base 253 and two noncrossing repeats at base 137. Open SIMPLE squares and filled LOCAL circles are connected within each pair, with milliseconds and LOCAL/SIMPLE ratios printed at right. The lower panel separately compares projection and attention event times for both histories. These device-event costs use their own clock; they are not components to add to the transaction wall clock.
